import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        long gcd = gcd(x, y);
        x /= gcd;
        y /= gcd;

        long res = 1000000000L;
        long resd = 1;

        if (y <= n) {
            System.out.println(x + "/" + y);
            return;
        }

        for (long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long cur = (x * i) / y;
            if (resd * Math.abs(x * i - cur * y) < i * Math.abs(x * resd - res * y)) {
                resd = i;
                res = cur;
            }
            cur++;
            if (resd * Math.abs(x * i - cur * y) < i * Math.abs(x * resd - res * y)) {
                resd = i;
                res = cur;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(res + "/" + resd);
        sc.close();
    }

    private static long gcd(long a, long b) {
        while (b != 0) {
            long temp = b;
            b = a % b;
            a = temp;
        }
        return a;
    }
}
